summary: Implement governed automatic work delegation across BusinessPartner, IntentionDesign, ImplementationDesign, CodingAndReparing, and Orchestrator while preserving stage-owned final accountability, hypothesis-bound evidence, singular verdicts, depth-two and concurrency-four limits, disjoint-write governance, bounded returns, singular failure disposition, behavior-proxy acceptance, and every existing quality gate.
notes: Global handoff approval: approvedByHuman=true; evidence is the accepted DT-00 through DT-15 humanDecision record plus the Orchestrator-dispatched full WorkPackage.

View binding: Motivation Viewpoint owns policy rationale; Outcome Realization Viewpoint owns capability-to-outcome production; Business Process Cooperation Viewpoint owns the ten-step responsibility chain; Application Cooperation Viewpoint owns stage-function orchestration and bounded-summary access; Implementation and Migration Viewpoint owns acceptance and handoff preparation.

Direct coverage scope comprises the fourteen testcase-owning policy and stage-function elements. Each functional point has a same-element mounted ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-AUTODEL mapping and a schema-supported acceptanceApproval attribute.

Context-only elements are the rejected-alternatives assessment, capability, outcome, three roles, bounded-summary data object, and ten business-process steps. They remain in the intent graph and bound views for architecture traceability but are excluded from intentElementIds because they are not independent implementation allocation boundaries; their observable behavior is owned by the fourteen directly covered policy and stage-function elements.
The direct dependency context contains no delivered boundary node because this is new implementation scope. Runner-owned deliveryStatus was not set or modified by IntentionDesign.

Implementation must create the single explicit entrypoint tests/explicit/entries/runAutomaticDelegationGovernance.js with DT-00 through DT-15 anchors, including DT-06-A through DT-06-E and DT-06-P, without weakening any existing stage, approval, handoff, audit, or delivery gate.
